notes: An AI agent can now build a whole set from your library: it picks tracks that mix in key and tempo, beat-matches them to one tempo, and renders preview audio of each transition so you can hear the blend before you play it.
Every track's structure - intro, builds, drops, outro - is now detected inside Liveolator, with no extra download needed.
Key detection is far more accurate. A flaw in the chroma analysis made most tracks collapse onto the same few keys; on a real test library correct keys went from 2 in 10 to 8 in 10.
Fixed tracks whose tempo read half again too fast - a 125 BPM track that came out as 168 now reads 125.
Scanning a folder now touches only that folder instead of re-walking your whole library, so a small rescan takes seconds instead of an hour.
You can now correct a track's BPM or key by hand and have that correction survive every later scan.
